findings.title: Provider PASS overrides execution failure
findings.severityRationale: An attacker-controlled provider can bypass a required verification gate.
evidence: Synthetic source returns a provider decision without checking timeout or exit status.
findings.attackerPrerequisites: Ability to supply a required provider result.
findings.attackScenario: Provider returns PASS while its process times out; the consumer accepts the claim.
findings.impact: Unverified artifacts can pass the configured gate.
findings.controlsConsidered: The process outcome exists but is unused; this is synthetic evidence, not a finding in the Panda projects.
findings.remediation: Validate process success and required evidence before accepting provider verdicts.
findings.regression: Reject PASS with timeout/nonzero exit; retain a successful matching control. Proposed, not executed by this example.

verification.detail: Illustrative synthetic report only; not an actual audit or model result.

limitations: Synthetic example; no scanner was launched.
Example data demonstrates report structure, not successful scanning or remediation.
